messages.translation: Muhtasari wa sarafu za ankara zilizohifadhiwa

messages.english: Saved invoices on this device, across all loaded dates. Choose one currency to view its recorded amounts.
messages.translation: Ankara zilizohifadhiwa kwenye kifaa hiki, katika tarehe zote zilizopakiwa. Chagua sarafu moja ili kuona kiasi chake kilichorekodiwa.

messages.english: DEMO — these are sample invoice amounts.
messages.translation: DEMO — haya ni mahesabu ya ankara za mfano.

messages.english: Saved invoice records changed or need review. Totals are unavailable. Refresh the current records before choosing a currency.
messages.translation: Kumbukumbu za ankara zilizohifadhiwa zilibadilika au zinahitaji ukaguzi. Jumla haipatikani. Onyesha upya kumbukumbu za sasa kabla ya kuchagua sarafu.

messages.english: Choose a currency to view invoice counts and amounts.
messages.translation: Chagua sarafu ili kuona idadi na kiasi cha ankara.

messages.english: Invoice-only amounts exclude pending link drafts, external sales records and costs. Recorded paid reflects the saved invoice status; it is not proof of bank receipt, cash income or profit. No currency conversion is made.
messages.translation: Kiasi cha ankara pekee hakijumuishi rasimu za viungo vinavyosubiri, kumbukumbu za mauzo ya nje na gharama. Zilizolipwa zilizorekodiwa zinaonyesha hali ya ankara iliyohifadhiwa; si thibitisho la risiti ya benki, mapato ya fedha taslimu au faida. Hakuna ubadilishaji wa sarafu unaofanywa.
